TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the ATM.

ReconciliationIdentification.name: Reconciliation Identification
ReconciliationIdentification.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period assigned by the ATM.

CreditorLabel.name: Creditor Label
CreditorLabel.definition: Description of the transfer for the creditor.

DebtorLabel.name: Debtor Label
DebtorLabel.definition: Description of the transfer for the debtor.

AccountFrom.name: Account From
AccountFrom.definition: Information about the source account of the transfer.

ProtectedAccountFrom.name: Protected Account From
ProtectedAccountFrom.definition: Encryption of the source account information.

AccountTo.name: Account To
AccountTo.definition: Information about the destination account of the transfer.

ProtectedAccountTo.name: Protected Account To
ProtectedAccountTo.definition: Encryption of the destination account information.

TotalRequestedAmount.name: Total Requested Amount
TotalRequestedAmount.definition: Amount of the transaction to be authorised.

DetailedRequestedAmount.name: Detailed Requested Amount
DetailedRequestedAmount.definition: Details of the transfer transaction amounts.

RequestedExecutionDate.name: Requested Execution Date
RequestedExecutionDate.definition: Requested date of the execution of the transfer.

RecurringTransfer.name: Recurring Transfer
RecurringTransfer.definition: Information for reccurring transfer or standing orders.

RequestedReceipt.name: Requested Receipt
RequestedReceipt.definition: True if the customer has requested a receipt.|Usage: When absent, default value is False.

ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Sequence of one or more TLV data elements from the ATM application, in accordance with ISO 7816-6, not in a specific order. Present if the transaction is performed with an EMV chip card application.
